title: Educational attainment and cognitive profile heterogeneity: age-stratified web-based analysis finds no detectable association

contributions.purpose: 构建独立于总体智力的认知剖面异质性指标
contributions.mechanism: 11 子测验年龄分层百分位的 within-person 全距与 IQR 作离散度
contributions.evaluation: 与 Grand Index 相关 r=0.0121(p=.69)/0.0633(p=.037),均 <判别效度基准 |r|<0.20
contributions.domain: 认知心理测量/教育与认知(社科)
contributions.source_quote: indices that demonstrated discriminant validity from general cognitive ability

contributions.purpose: 检验教育程度是否预测剖面异质性
contributions.mechanism: 多元回归+Bonferroni 校正(α=0.025),协变量年龄/性别/国别/时段
contributions.source_quote: Multiple regression analyses with correction for multiple testing did not detect associations between educational attainment and cognitive profile heterogeneity

contributions.purpose: 检验年龄调节及结果稳健性
contributions.mechanism: 年龄分层交互模型+敏感性分析(CV 指标/合并教育类别/2.5SD 离群/劈半信度)
contributions.evaluation: 交互不显著(R²=0.013/0.019,所有交互 p>.025);敏感性分析一致零结果
contributions.source_quote: age-stratified analyses failed to support predictions that education-heterogeneity relationships would strengthen in older adults
